source: Illustrative example, hand-made to match how real models behave.
task: Find why last week's signups dropped and draft a fix.

steps.title: Pin down the drop
steps.detail: Queries the signups table by day and channel. Signups fell 31% starting Tuesday, almost entirely on mobile web.

steps.title: Check what shipped
steps.detail: Reads the release notes and the changelog for last week. Tuesday's deploy changed the signup form's email validation.

steps.title: Look for known issues
steps.detail: Searches for reports of the same validation library failing on mobile browsers. Finds a bug affecting plus-addressed emails on iOS.

steps.title: Confirm the cause
steps.detail: Replays failed form submissions from the logs. 94% of rejected emails contain a plus sign, so the validator is the cause.

steps.title: Ask about the fix
steps.detail: Asks whether to loosen the validation or roll back Tuesday's deploy, since the choice affects other work in flight.

steps.title: Draft the fix
steps.detail: Writes a patch that accepts plus-addressed emails, adds a regression test, and drafts a short summary for the team.
